fp.fragment: Function/Sub lambdas convert to delegates; closures capture containing locals

fp.price: Captured locals extend lifetime until the delegate is collected.

sources.quote: A lambda expression is a function or subroutine without a name that can be used wherever a delegate is valid.
When a lambda expression refers to a local variable or parameter, the lambda expression captures the variable being referred to into a closure.

oop.why: Forms, controls, and .NET libraries are class-shaped.
oop.price: Late binding via Object if you skip early types.

decl.reason: Visual Basic is an imperative OOP language. Query syntax is not the language core.

static.price: Loose typing defers method binding until run-time.

hm.reason: Local inference exists; the language is not Hindley–Milner.

dep.reason: No dependent types. Generics parameterize types, not values in types.

gen.fragment: Of T generics on classes/procedures; constructed types replace type parameters

sources.quote: A generic type is a single programming element that adapts to perform the same functionality for multiple data types.

malloc.reason: Managed objects are CLI GC-allocated. Authors do not malloc/free the VB heap.
